text.sourceText: Tara na! In English, this phrase translates as “Let’s go!” And with the 7,107 islands that comprise the Philippine archipelago, there are many places to visit and things to see. Popular tourist destinations in the Philippines include Baguio in the province of Benguet and Tagaytay in the province of Cavite, both on the island of Luzon. Both cities are located in the mountains and, because of their high elevation, benefit from cooler climates than most parts of the tropical Philippines, which makes them popular resorts in the summer.
text.id: Tara na! dalam bahasa Inggris, frase ini diterjemahkan sebagai "Ayo pergi!" dan dengan 7.107 pulau yang terdiri dari archipago Filipina, ada banyak tempat untuk dikunjungi dan dilihat oleh para turis populer di Filipina termasuk Baguio di provinsi Benguet dan Tagalaytay di provinsi Cavite, baik di pulau Luzon. Kedua kota terletak di pegunungan dan, karena ketinggian tinggi mereka, manfaat dari iklim yang lebih dingin daripada sebagian besar bagian Filipina tropis, yang membuat mereka resort populer di musim panas.

text.sourceText: Lion Head in Baguio City that welcomes visitors to the City of Pines
text.id: Kepala Singa di Baguio City yang menyambut pengunjung ke City of Pines

text.sourceText: Tagaytay is home to Picnic Grove, a sprawling area of lush vegetation where visitors can go zip lining or horseback riding within sight of the Taal Volcano, one of the world’s smallest volcanoes. Taal Volcano and the lake that surrounds it can also be viewed from the highest point in Tagaytay, the People’s Park in the Sky, a former palace built by President Ferdinand Marcos that is now a tourist attraction because of its superb vistas of the surrounding landscape.
text.id: Tagaytay adalah rumah untuk Picnic Grove, area luas vegetasi subur dimana pengunjung dapat pergi zip lining atau menunggang kuda dalam pandangan Taal Volcano, salah satu gunung berapi terkecil di dunia. Taal Volcano dan danau yang mengelilinginya juga dapat dilihat dari titik tertinggi di Tagaytay, Taman Rakyat di Langit, sebuah istana yang dibangun oleh Presiden Ferdinand Marcos yang sekarang merupakan daya tarik wisata karena pemandangan yang luar biasa dari lanskap sekitarnya.

text.sourceText: Daniel Burnham, an American architect who served in the United States colonial government in the Philippines from 1898 to 1945, designed the layout of the modern city of Baguio in 1904. Baguio is known as “the Summer Capital of the Philippines” because of its popularity with Filipino tourists during the hottest months, when Baguio remains reasonably cool.
text.id: Daniel Burnham, seorang arsitek Amerika yang bertugas di pemerintahan kolonial Amerika Serikat di Filipina dari tahun 1898 sampai 1945, merancang tata letak kota Baguio modern pada tahun 1904.

text.sourceText: Other popular tourist sites include Boracay, an island in the Visayan islands. Considered by many as having some of the best beaches in the world, Boracay has developed into a beautiful resort catering to both local and international travelers who want to snorkel, dive, sail, or just lounge on the white sands and soak up the sun.
text.id: Situs wisata populer lainnya termasuk Boracay, sebuah pulau di kepulauan Visayan yang dianggap oleh banyak orang yang memiliki pantai terbaik di dunia, Boracay telah berkembang menjadi resor yang indah katering untuk baik lokal dan internasional wisatawan yang ingin snorkel, menyelam, berlayar, atau hanya lounge di pasir putih dan merendam matahari.

text.sourceText: The Philippines is home to a wide diversity of cultures and peoples, and festivals are a common way for communities throughout the country to celebrate their heritage and history. For example, the Ati-Atihan Festival is celebrated in Kalibo, Aklan Province, on Panay Island. Participants don tribal costumes that reflect the pre-Hispanic cultures of the region and perform dances and music as they parade down the street. Many festivals combine indigenous elements such as costumes and dances with Spanish elements, particularly those from the Catholic tradition, for example the processing of religious icons and performing of special masses.
text.id: Filipina adalah rumah bagi keragaman budaya dan masyarakat, dan festival adalah cara umum bagi masyarakat di seluruh negeri untuk merayakan warisan dan sejarah mereka sebagai contoh, Festival Ati- Atihan dirayakan di Kalibo, Provinsi Aklan, Pulau Panay. Peserta mengenakan kostum suku yang mencerminkan budaya sebelum Hispanik di wilayah tersebut dan melakukan tarian dan musik saat mereka parade di jalan. Banyak festival menggabungkan unsur-unsur pribumi seperti kostum dan tarian dengan unsur-unsur Spanyol, terutama mereka dari tradisi Katolik, misalnya pengolahan ikon agama dan melakukan massa khusus.

text.sourceText: “Hala bira! Puwera Pasma!” Performers and devotees dancing and chanting during the Ati-Atihan Festival
text.id: "Hala Bara! Puwera Pasma!" Performers dan pemuja menari dan bernyanyi selama Festival Ati- Atihan

text.sourceText: Another famous festival where the mixture of cultures can be seen is the Flores de Mayo (Spanish for “Flowers of May”), a month-long celebration in May observed throughout the Tagalog regions of the island of Luzon. The festival was introduced by the Spaniards in honor of the Virgin Mary, whom Filipinos fondly call Mama Mary and lavish with the local flowers in bloom. It has become a colorful celebration that includes the decoration of homes with copious flowers and the building of floral floats and culminates in a parade called Santacruzan. During the month of May, children and adults dressed in their Sunday best come together in the afternoons to pray the rosary and offer flowers to Mama Mary. Many villages and towns have their own festivals, with feasts, parades, and beautiful decorations, and these have become favorite attractions for tourists.
text.id: Festival lain yang terkenal di mana campuran budaya dapat dilihat adalah Flores de Mayo (Spanyol untuk "Flowers of May"), perayaan panjang bulan pada Mei diamati seluruh daerah Tagalog dari pulau Luzon. Festival ini diperkenalkan oleh Spanyol untuk menghormati Perawan Maria, yang Filipinos panggilan sayang Mama Mary dan mewah dengan bunga lokal bermekaran. Selama bulan Mei, anak-anak dan orang dewasa berpakaian di hari Minggu terbaik datang bersama-sama di sore hari untuk berdoa rosario dan menawarkan bunga untuk Mama Mary.

text.sourceText: Historical sites are also popular among travelers in the Philippines. Cities such as Vigan, Ilocos Sur, Luzon—a UNESCO World Heritage Site for its well-preserved Spanish architecture—and Iloilo City in the Visayas, one of the principal cities during the Spanish colonial period, are a constant draw for fans of history and architecture. The Rice Terraces in Banawe, Ifugao Province (in Tagalog: “Hagdan-hagdang Palayan ng Banawe”) are another attraction. They were constructed by the Ifugao people, using only the simplest tools and their own hands. Built over 2,000 years ago and maintained by the Ifugao since that time, the terraces have been called by some the Eighth Wonder of the World.
text.id: Situs historis juga populer di kalangan wisatawan di Filipina, kota-kota seperti Vigan, Ilocos Sur, Luzon - UNESCO World Heritage Site untuk arsitektur Spanyol yang terawetkan - dan Iloilo City di Visasing, salah satu kota utama selama periode kolonial Spanyol, adalah gambar konstan bagi penggemar sejarah dan arsitektur. Teras Rice di Bangrass, Provinsi Ifugao (di Tagalog: "Hagdan-hagdang Palayan ng Banguest") adalah atraksi lain. mereka dibangun oleh orang-orang Ifugao, hanya menggunakan alat-alat sederhana dan tangan mereka sendiri. Dibangun lebih dari 2.000 tahun yang lalu dan dipelihara oleh Ifugao sejak saat itu, kelompok-kelompok tersebut dipanggil oleh Keajaiban Kedelapan Dunia.

text.sourceText: So, when you visit the Philippines, plan to explore the many beautiful landscapes and experience the full cultural and historical diversity that this archipelago has to offer. Tara na!
text.id: Jadi, ketika Anda mengunjungi Filipina, berencana untuk menjelajahi banyak pemandangan indah dan mengalami keragaman budaya dan sejarah penuh bahwa kepulauan ini ditawarkan.
